parameters.command:
=set -eu
execution_id='{{$execution.id}}'
case "$execution_id" in
  ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo 'Invalid n8n execution ID' >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
repo_dir="/tmp/crunchy-calendar-$execution_id"
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$repo_dir"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
state_dir="${CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR:-}"
if [ -z "$state_dir" ]; then echo 'CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR is required' >&2; exit 78; fi
case "$state_dir" in /*) ;; *) echo 'CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR must be absolute' >&2; exit 78 ;; esac
case "$state_dir" in *'/../'*|*/..|*'/./'*|*/.) echo 'CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR must not contain dot traversal' >&2; exit 78 ;; esac
case "$state_dir" in /|/tmp|/tmp/*|/var|/home|/home/node|"$repo_dir"|"$repo_dir"/*) echo 'CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR is too broad or temporary' >&2; exit 78 ;; esac
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'python3 is not installed on the n8n execution host' >&2; exit 69; }
test -f "$repo_dir/crunchy_calendar/__main__.py" || { echo 'Git checkout does not contain crunchy_calendar/__main__.py' >&2; exit 66; }
mkdir -p -- "$state_dir"
test -w "$state_dir" || { echo 'CRUNCHY_CALENDAR_STATE_DIR is not writable' >&2; exit 73; }
cd "$repo_dir"
python3 -m crunchy_calendar --discover --discovery-state "$state_dir/discovery.json"
